name: @vaipakam/anvil-harness
description: Node-only test harness for the local-Anvil tiers: JSON-RPC control of an anvil node (time travel, balances, state dump), spawning one, and deploying the repository's CURRENT contracts onto it from source (contracts/script/e2e/DeployE2EFixture.s.sol), and a local CCIP lane between two such nodes with the relay that carries it (contracts/script/e2e/E2ELocalCcip.sol). Shared by the connected app's e2e suite (apps/app/e2e) and the keeper's Anvil scenarios (apps/keeper/e2e). Never imported by runtime code: it spawns processes and reads the filesystem.
